decisions.reason: The Lp quotient and local-integrability Definitions do not assert measurability of products. The monomial is continuous, hence Borel measurable, by cor-continuous-functions-are-borel-measurable; the real and imaginary parts multiply measurably by clause 4 of thm-arithmetic-and-lattice-operations-preserve-measurability. The a.e. bound on a bounded finite-volume cube proves absolute integrability of every required moment. The atom conditions, legal moment orders and representative-support caveat are preserved.

The rectangle Definition does not supply a distance estimate. L1 now cites lem-distance-to-set-is-lipschitz with the nonempty complement of a proper open set, proves positivity from an interior ball and vanishing outside Omega, and cites def-metric-ball for balls. Checked the greedy recursion, covering bound 15rho_i/49<rho_i/2, radius comparison by factor 7, and packing bound 392^n<=785^n. The Statement and all four cover properties are unchanged; only proof prerequisites and the grid enumeration convention were repaired.

The cube supplier uses coordinate indices r<n; coordinate 1 is unavailable at n=1. Replaced the cut, center coordinate and approach vector by x_0,c_{Q,0},e_0. Equal box measures prove cancellation and the closed cube contains the support. At every interior point of the slice, opposite approach paths have values +/-|Q|^{-1}, contradicting continuity. The refuted claim and witness formula are unchanged; this repairs the proof convention without altering the counterexample interface.

Read MSV section 1, printed pp.15-16 (PDF pp.1-2), from a successful full PDF retrieval and local extraction: its radial grand class B_N controls derivatives through N and requires N>1+n/p. DKKP printed p.60 defines the nontangential F_N with derivatives through N+1 and records N>=floor(n/p)+1. Corrected the source comparison while preserving P_N,F_N,M_N, monotonicity and the unspecified local admissibility threshold. The same erroneous MSV attribution remains in the unassigned maximal-characterisation theorem Statement and is routed to its frontier owner.

The original truncated grand supremum used radial evaluations, so its monotone limit was the radial grand supremum rather than the supplied cone supremum M_N. Changed only its defining carrier to sup_{psi in F_N} M_{psi,1}^{epsilon,L}. Extended step 1.3 to translated tests theta(w)=psi(w+(z-x)/t), with S_M norm<=2^M for the fixed deconvolution order M and weight ratio<=2^L; thus the same tangential estimate retains constants independent of N,epsilon. F7 now proves Borel measurability by open-ball superlevels, and step 1.5 proves every stated monotone limit, including equality of strict and closed cone suprema by continuity. Finiteness, extended-average estimates, and both good-set estimates remain valid; the zero untruncated case is explicit. The displayed truncation formulas explicitly include every Schwartz test, even tests of zero integral; only the comparison kernel requires nonzero integral.

The given cut x_1=c_{Q,1} is undefined in dimension one under the cube supplier. Replaced it with coordinate 0. The strict halves are measurable boxes of equal measure; their indicator difference vanishes outside the closed cube, obeys the pointwise size bound and has integral zero. The uniform atom lemma at p=1,s=0 and the stated fixed admissible order/kernel supplies the asserted H1 norm bound. The Example section and its mathematical claim remain unchanged.

The level-decomposition supplier gives C(n,p,N,K,varphi,Phi), so F1 omitted actual kernel data. Restored that dependence and fixed one admissible auxiliary Phi_{n,K} for each integer pair (n,K), using the already assumed Countable Choice. Applying decomposition with this fixed family gives a constant depending on n,p,N,K,varphi, as claimed; it requires no uniformity over arbitrary auxiliary kernels because the atomic infimum is intrinsic. Checked n+s+1=floor(n/p)+1, so the stated N meets the decomposition and atom-sum thresholds. The two implications, infimum bounds and every-representation tail convergence follow from the actual suppliers. The Statement remains byte-identical.

The displayed Statement already requires x^alpha f in L1 through s; the title omitted this essential condition. For n=1,p=1/2, disjoint translates of a nonzero compactly supported (p,infinity,1)-atom with coefficients 2^{-j} and centers 4^j have summable ell^p coefficients and L1 norms, whereas integral |x f| diverges. Qualified the title by weighted integrability without changing the Statement. Checked differentiation under integrable weighted dominators and the lowest nonzero homogeneous Taylor term against little-o(|xi|^gamma), including gamma=0 and integer gamma. Also supplied the previously abbreviated H1-to-L1 argument via atomic ell1 summation, complex L1 completeness and injectivity of regular distributions; step 4.1 now cites that fact.
